text: Cooking is a magical process that transforms ordinary ingredients into delightful meals. One of the most essential tools in this process is the onion and garlic. These pungent and flavorful ingredients, when sautéed or caramelized, add depth and richness to dishes. Onions and garlic, when properly cooked, not only enhance the taste but also provide essential nutrients and antioxidants. Whether you're preparing a hearty stew, a savory sauce, or a simple salad, onions and garlic are the backbone of many beloved recipes, adding a universal and irresistible flavor that warms the heart and satisfies the senses.
summary: Cooking transforms ingredients into delicious meals using onions and garlic.
